instructions: Translate only the khmer field for each entry. Leave english unchanged.
This file lists user-visible Kepler's Laws simulation text: screens, controls, dialogs, preferences, warnings, keyboard help, and shared PhET menu/settings chrome.
Kepler's Laws has no separate practice pages; screens are First Law, Second Law, Third Law, and All Laws.
Keep placeholders such as {{value}}, {{units}}, {{period}}, {{axis}}, {{message}}, {{name}}, {{screens}}, {0}, and HTML tags such as <b>, <sup>, <sub> unchanged.
Mathematical symbols (a, b, c, T, v, AU, etc.) may stay Latin if that is preferred for science teaching; still fill khmer if you want a Khmer form.
Accessibility (a11y) strings are spoken/read by screen readers and should also be translated.

entries.english: Planet's position vector (|r| and θr): the vector magnitude |r| is equal to the distance between the star and the planet. The vector direction (θr) is measured with respect to the horizontal.
